note: Seed list for scripts/agent-watch-admit.mjs (2026-09-22). A candidate becomes a registry record ONLY when its official page answers 2xx on the day it is checked; rejects are logged in data/agent-watch-admissions.json and retried by the daily run. repo_url null = no public repository (rendered as such, never as a broken link). source_url == repo_url = the repository is the project's official page. Descriptions carry no star counts, user counts or prices — those are numbers nobody here verified.

candidates.name: LangChain
candidates.description: Open-source framework for building LLM applications and agents in Python and JavaScript, with a hosted platform for deployment and tracing.
candidates.zh_description: 用 Python 与 JavaScript 构建 LLM 应用和智能体的开源框架，另有托管平台负责部署与追踪。

candidates.name: LlamaIndex
candidates.description: Open-source data framework for connecting LLMs and agents to documents and data, with a hosted parsing and indexing service.
candidates.zh_description: 把 LLM 与智能体接到文档和数据上的开源数据框架，另有托管的解析与索引服务。

candidates.name: Haystack
candidates.description: Open-source Python framework from deepset for composing retrieval, generation and agent pipelines.
candidates.zh_description: deepset 出品的开源 Python 框架，用于组合检索、生成与智能体流水线。

candidates.name: Vercel AI SDK
candidates.description: Open-source TypeScript toolkit for building AI apps and agents across web frameworks, with provider-agnostic model calls and tool use.
candidates.zh_description: 面向各类 Web 框架的开源 TypeScript 工具包，统一调用多家模型并支持工具使用，用于构建 AI 应用与智能体。

candidates.name: MetaGPT
candidates.description: Open-source multi-agent framework that assigns software-company roles to LLM agents to turn a one-line requirement into design and code.
candidates.zh_description: 把软件公司的角色分配给 LLM 智能体、从一句需求生成设计与代码的开源多智能体框架。

candidates.name: AutoGPT
candidates.description: Open-source platform for building, running and scheduling autonomous agents with a visual block editor, plus a hosted edition.
candidates.zh_description: 带可视化积木编辑器的开源平台，用于构建、运行和定时调度自主智能体，另有托管版。

candidates.name: SuperAGI
candidates.description: Open-source framework for provisioning and running autonomous agents with a web console and a marketplace of tools.
candidates.zh_description: 带网页控制台与工具市场的开源框架，用于配置并运行自主智能体。

candidates.name: Griptape
candidates.description: Open-source Python framework for agents, pipelines and workflows with a hosted cloud for deployment.
candidates.zh_description: 用于智能体、流水线与工作流的开源 Python 框架，另有托管云负责部署。

candidates.name: DSPy
candidates.description: Stanford's open-source framework for programming language-model pipelines declaratively and optimizing their prompts and weights.
candidates.zh_description: 斯坦福出品的开源框架，以声明式方式编写语言模型流水线并自动优化提示词与权重。

candidates.name: Instructor
candidates.description: Open-source library for getting validated, typed structured output from LLMs, with ports to several languages.
candidates.zh_description: 从 LLM 获得经校验的类型化结构化输出的开源库，已移植到多种语言。

candidates.name: Outlines
candidates.description: Open-source library for constrained generation that guarantees LLM output matches a schema, regex or grammar.
candidates.zh_description: 约束生成的开源库，保证 LLM 输出符合给定的 schema、正则或语法。

candidates.name: Guidance
candidates.description: Open-source language for controlling LLM generation with interleaved constraints and tool calls.
candidates.zh_description: 以交错的约束与工具调用控制 LLM 生成的开源编程语言。

candidates.name: BeeAI Framework
candidates.description: Open-source agent framework under the Linux Foundation with Python and TypeScript editions and agent-to-agent interoperability.
candidates.zh_description: Linux 基金会旗下的开源智能体框架，提供 Python 与 TypeScript 两版并支持智能体互操作。

candidates.name: Julep
candidates.description: Open-source platform for stateful, long-running agent workflows with built-in memory and task scheduling.
candidates.zh_description: 面向有状态、长时运行智能体工作流的开源平台，内置记忆与任务调度。

candidates.name: Agency Swarm
candidates.description: Open-source Python framework for building collaborating agent teams with defined roles and communication flows.
candidates.zh_description: 构建带明确角色与沟通流程的协作智能体团队的开源 Python 框架。

candidates.name: Atomic Agents
candidates.description: Open-source Python framework for composing agents from small, schema-typed components.
candidates.zh_description: 用小型、带 schema 类型的组件拼装智能体的开源 Python 框架。

candidates.name: Langroid
candidates.description: Open-source Python framework where agents collaborate by exchanging messages, with tool use and retrieval built in.
candidates.zh_description: 智能体通过消息交换协作的开源 Python 框架，内置工具使用与检索。

candidates.name: Rivet
candidates.description: Open-source visual programming environment from Ironclad for building and debugging LLM agent graphs.
candidates.zh_description: Ironclad 出品的开源可视化编程环境，用于构建和调试 LLM 智能体图。

candidates.name: Prompt flow
candidates.description: Microsoft's open-source toolkit for building, evaluating and deploying LLM flows from prototype to production.
candidates.zh_description: 微软开源的工具集，覆盖 LLM 流程从原型到生产的构建、评测与部署。

candidates.name: TaskWeaver
candidates.description: Microsoft's open-source code-first agent framework that plans tasks and executes them as generated Python.
candidates.zh_description: 微软开源的代码优先智能体框架，先规划任务再以生成的 Python 执行。

candidates.name: Strands Agents
candidates.description: AWS's open-source model-driven agent SDK with native MCP tool support.
candidates.zh_description: AWS 开源的模型驱动智能体 SDK，原生支持 MCP 工具。

candidates.name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.description: AWS's managed runtime, memory, gateway and browser tooling for deploying agents built with any framework.
candidates.zh_description: AWS 托管的智能体运行时、记忆、网关与浏览器工具，可部署任意框架构建的智能体。

candidates.name: Spring AI
candidates.description: Open-source Spring project bringing model calls, tool use, retrieval and MCP to Java applications.
candidates.zh_description: 把模型调用、工具使用、检索与 MCP 带进 Java 应用的开源 Spring 项目。

candidates.name: LangChain4j
candidates.description: Open-source Java library for LLM apps and agents, independent of the Python LangChain project.
candidates.zh_description: 面向 Java 的开源 LLM 应用与智能体库，与 Python 版 LangChain 相互独立。

candidates.name: Koog
candidates.description: JetBrains' open-source Kotlin framework for building agents that run on the JVM and Kotlin Multiplatform.
candidates.zh_description: JetBrains 开源的 Kotlin 智能体框架，可运行在 JVM 与 Kotlin 多平台上。

candidates.name: Rig
candidates.description: Open-source Rust library for building modular, provider-agnostic LLM applications and agents.
candidates.zh_description: 构建模块化、与供应商无关的 LLM 应用与智能体的开源 Rust 库。

candidates.name: Genkit
candidates.description: Google's open-source framework for building AI flows and agents in JavaScript, Go and Python with a local developer UI.
candidates.zh_description: Google 开源的框架，用 JavaScript、Go 与 Python 构建 AI 流程和智能体，并附本地开发者界面。

candidates.name: Eino
candidates.description: ByteDance's open-source Go framework for composing LLM applications and agents from typed components.
candidates.zh_description: 字节跳动开源的 Go 框架，用类型化组件组合 LLM 应用与智能体。

candidates.name: AgentScope
candidates.description: Alibaba's open-source multi-agent platform with message-passing agents, MCP support and a visual studio.
candidates.zh_description: 阿里开源的多智能体平台，以消息传递组织智能体，支持 MCP 并附可视化工作台。

candidates.name: Qwen-Agent
candidates.description: Open-source framework from the Qwen team for building agents with function calling, code execution and retrieval on Qwen models.
candidates.zh_description: Qwen 团队开源的智能体框架，基于 Qwen 模型提供函数调用、代码执行与检索。

candidates.name: ModelScope-Agent
candidates.description: Open-source agent framework from ModelScope that connects open models to tools and APIs.
candidates.zh_description: ModelScope 开源的智能体框架，把开源模型接到工具与 API 上。

candidates.name: XAgent
candidates.description: OpenBMB's open-source autonomous agent that plans and executes complex tasks with a dispatcher, planner and actor.
candidates.zh_description: OpenBMB 开源的自主智能体，用调度器、规划器与执行器完成复杂任务。

candidates.name: ChatDev
candidates.description: Open-source virtual software company where role-playing agents collaborate to produce software.
candidates.zh_description: 由角色扮演的智能体协作产出软件的开源虚拟软件公司。

candidates.name: Lagent
candidates.description: InternLM's open-source lightweight framework for building LLM-based agents.
candidates.zh_description: InternLM 开源的轻量级 LLM 智能体框架。

candidates.name: Deep Agents
candidates.description: LangChain's open-source harness for long-horizon agents with planning, sub-agents and a file system.
candidates.zh_description: LangChain 开源的长程智能体框架，带规划、子智能体与文件系统。

candidates.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
candidates.description: Microsoft's open-source framework unifying AutoGen and Semantic Kernel ideas for building agents and workflows in .NET and Python.
candidates.zh_description: 微软开源的智能体框架，融合 AutoGen 与 Semantic Kernel 的思路，支持 .NET 与 Python。

candidates.name: Agent2Agent Protocol (A2A)
candidates.description: Open protocol, started by Google and now under the Linux Foundation, for agents from different vendors to discover and talk to each other.
candidates.zh_description: 由 Google 发起、现归 Linux 基金会的开放协议，让不同厂商的智能体相互发现并通信。

candidates.name: Agent Protocol
candidates.description: Open API specification for driving agents with a common tasks-and-steps interface.
candidates.zh_description: 以统一的任务与步骤接口驱动智能体的开放 API 规范。

candidates.name: AG-UI Protocol
candidates.description: Open event-based protocol connecting agent backends to front-end user interfaces.
candidates.zh_description: 以事件流把智能体后端接到前端界面的开放协议。

candidates.name: CopilotKit
candidates.description: Open-source React components and runtime for embedding agents and copilots into web apps.
candidates.zh_description: 把智能体与副驾驶嵌进 Web 应用的开源 React 组件与运行时。

candidates.name: assistant-ui
candidates.description: Open-source TypeScript and React primitives for building chat and agent interfaces.
candidates.zh_description: 构建对话与智能体界面的开源 TypeScript / React 基础组件。

candidates.name: Chainlit
candidates.description: Open-source Python framework for building a chat interface around an LLM app or agent quickly.
candidates.zh_description: 为 LLM 应用或智能体快速搭出对话界面的开源 Python 框架。

candidates.name: Llama Stack
candidates.description: Meta's open-source standard APIs and distributions for building agentic applications on Llama models.
candidates.zh_description: Meta 开源的标准 API 与发行版，用于在 Llama 模型上构建智能体应用。

candidates.name: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS)
candidates.description: OpenAI's open-source TypeScript edition of the Agents SDK with handoffs, guardrails and realtime voice agents.
candidates.zh_description: OpenAI 开源的 Agents SDK TypeScript 版，带交接、护栏与实时语音智能体。

candidates.name: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit
candidates.description: NVIDIA's open-source library for connecting, profiling and evaluating agents across frameworks.
candidates.zh_description: NVIDIA 开源的库，用于跨框架连接、剖析与评测智能体。

candidates.name: Marvin
candidates.description: Prefect's open-source Python toolkit for agentic workflows built from typed functions.
candidates.zh_description: Prefect 开源的 Python 工具包，用类型化函数搭建智能体工作流。

candidates.name: Burr
candidates.description: Open-source state-machine framework for agents and applications with a built-in tracing UI, now an Apache project.
candidates.zh_description: 带内置追踪界面的开源状态机框架，用于智能体与应用，现为 Apache 项目。

candidates.name: Mirascope
candidates.description: Open-source Python toolkit for provider-agnostic LLM calls, tools and structured outputs.
candidates.zh_description: 与供应商无关的开源 Python 工具包，覆盖 LLM 调用、工具与结构化输出。

candidates.name: BAML
candidates.description: Open-source domain-specific language for defining typed LLM functions and structured outputs across host languages.
candidates.zh_description: 定义类型化 LLM 函数与结构化输出的开源领域专用语言，支持多种宿主语言。

candidates.name: magentic
candidates.description: Open-source Python library that turns decorated functions into LLM calls with typed outputs.
candidates.zh_description: 把带装饰器的函数变成带类型输出的 LLM 调用的开源 Python 库。

candidates.name: Swarms
candidates.description: Open-source Python framework for multi-agent architectures with a hosted marketplace.
candidates.zh_description: 面向多智能体架构的开源 Python 框架，另有托管市场。

candidates.name: AgentVerse
candidates.description: OpenBMB's open-source framework for task-solving and simulation with many agents.
candidates.zh_description: OpenBMB 开源的多智能体任务求解与仿真框架。

candidates.name: AIOS
candidates.description: Open-source agent operating system that schedules, isolates and serves LLM agents like processes.
candidates.zh_description: 把 LLM 智能体当作进程来调度、隔离与服务的开源智能体操作系统。

candidates.name: AgentGPT
candidates.description: Open-source web app for configuring and running autonomous agents in the browser.
candidates.zh_description: 在浏览器里配置并运行自主智能体的开源网页应用。

candidates.name: Agent Zero
candidates.description: Open-source general-purpose agent that runs in Docker, uses the OS as a tool and keeps persistent memory.
candidates.zh_description: 运行在 Docker 里的开源通用智能体，把操作系统当工具并保留持久记忆。

candidates.name: txtai
candidates.description: Open-source all-in-one embeddings database with workflows and agents for semantic search and RAG.
candidates.zh_description: 集成工作流与智能体的开源一体化向量数据库，用于语义搜索与 RAG。

candidates.name: ControlFlow
candidates.description: Open-source Python framework from Prefect for task-centric agentic workflows.
candidates.zh_description: Prefect 开源的以任务为中心的智能体工作流 Python 框架。

candidates.name: Spring AI Alibaba
candidates.description: Alibaba's open-source Java agent framework built on Spring AI with graph workflows and MCP support.
candidates.zh_description: 阿里基于 Spring AI 开源的 Java 智能体框架，支持图式工作流与 MCP。

candidates.name: Youtu-Agent
candidates.description: Tencent's open-source agent framework aimed at open-weight models with configurable tools and evaluation.
candidates.zh_description: 腾讯开源的智能体框架，面向开源权重模型，提供可配置工具与评测。

candidates.name: ElizaOS
candidates.description: Open-source TypeScript framework for autonomous agents that connect to chat platforms and keep memory.
candidates.zh_description: 接入各类聊天平台并保留记忆的开源 TypeScript 自主智能体框架。

candidates.name: Agent Lightning
candidates.description: Microsoft's open-source framework for training and optimizing agents built with any framework using reinforcement learning.
candidates.zh_description: 微软开源的框架，用强化学习训练并优化任意框架构建的智能体。

candidates.name: Continue
candidates.description: Open-source IDE extension and CLI for custom coding agents and assistants with MCP support.
candidates.zh_description: 开源的 IDE 扩展与命令行工具，可定制编程智能体与助手，支持 MCP。

candidates.name: Cline
candidates.description: Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code that edits files, runs commands and uses MCP tools with your own model keys.
candidates.zh_description: VS Code 上的开源自主编程智能体，可改文件、跑命令、调用 MCP 工具，用你自己的模型 key。

candidates.name: Roo Code
candidates.description: Open-source VS Code coding agent with switchable modes and MCP tool support.
candidates.zh_description: 开源的 VS Code 编程智能体，支持多种模式切换与 MCP 工具。

candidates.name: Kilo Code
candidates.description: Open-source VS Code coding agent with orchestrated modes and a hosted model gateway.
candidates.zh_description: 开源的 VS Code 编程智能体，带编排模式与托管模型网关。

candidates.name: Gemini CLI
candidates.description: Google's open-source terminal agent for Gemini with file editing, shell commands, web search and MCP.
candidates.zh_description: Google 开源的 Gemini 终端智能体，支持改文件、跑 shell、联网搜索与 MCP。

candidates.name: OpenAI Codex
candidates.description: OpenAI's coding agent, available as an open-source terminal CLI and as a cloud agent inside ChatGPT.
candidates.zh_description: OpenAI 的编程智能体，提供开源终端 CLI，也以云端智能体形式内置于 ChatGPT。

candidates.name: Claude Code
candidates.description: Anthropic's terminal-based coding agent that edits code, runs commands and uses MCP servers, billed through Claude plans or API usage.
candidates.zh_description: Anthropic 的终端编程智能体，可改代码、跑命令、用 MCP 服务器，按 Claude 套餐或 API 用量计费。

candidates.name: Qwen Code
candidates.description: Open-source terminal coding agent from the Qwen team tuned for Qwen coder models.
candidates.zh_description: Qwen 团队开源的终端编程智能体，针对 Qwen 编程模型优化。

candidates.name: OpenCode
candidates.description: Open-source terminal coding agent that works with many model providers.
candidates.zh_description: 支持多家模型供应商的开源终端编程智能体。

candidates.name: Crush
candidates.description: Charm's open-source terminal coding agent with LSP and MCP integration.
candidates.zh_description: Charm 出品的开源终端编程智能体，集成 LSP 与 MCP。

candidates.name: Plandex
candidates.description: Open-source terminal agent for planning and executing large multi-file coding tasks with version-controlled changes.
candidates.zh_description: 规划并执行大型多文件编程任务的开源终端智能体，改动可版本控制。

candidates.name: Devin
candidates.description: Cognition's hosted autonomous software engineer that takes tickets and opens pull requests.
candidates.zh_description: Cognition 的托管自主软件工程师，接任务并提交 Pull Request。

candidates.name: Cursor
candidates.description: AI code editor with an agent mode that edits across files and runs commands.
candidates.zh_description: 带智能体模式的 AI 代码编辑器，可跨文件改动并执行命令。

candidates.name: Windsurf
candidates.description: AI code editor whose agent works across files and terminal in a shared context.
candidates.zh_description: 智能体在共享上下文中跨文件与终端工作的 AI 代码编辑器。

candidates.name: GitHub Copilot coding agent

candidates.zh_description: GitHub 的托管智能体，领取 issue 后在云端环境工作并提交 Pull Request。

candidates.name: Jules

candidates.zh_description: Google 的异步编程智能体，克隆仓库后在云端虚拟机工作并提出改动。

candidates.name: Kiro
candidates.description: AWS's agentic IDE that turns prompts into specs, tasks and code with hooks that run on events.
candidates.zh_description: AWS 的智能体式 IDE，把提示词变成规格、任务与代码，并可按事件触发钩子。

candidates.name: Trae
candidates.description: ByteDance's AI IDE with a builder mode, plus an open-source research agent for software-engineering tasks.
candidates.zh_description: 字节跳动的 AI IDE，带 Builder 模式，另开源一个面向软件工程任务的研究型智能体。

candidates.name: bolt.diy
candidates.description: Open-source edition of Bolt for building full-stack web apps in the browser with your choice of model.
candidates.zh_description: Bolt 的开源版，在浏览器里用自选模型生成全栈 Web 应用。

candidates.name: Replit Agent
candidates.description: Replit's hosted agent that builds, runs and deploys applications from a description.
candidates.zh_description: Replit 的托管智能体，根据描述构建、运行并部署应用。

candidates.name: SWE-agent
candidates.description: Open-source research agent from Princeton and Stanford that fixes issues in GitHub repositories.
candidates.zh_description: 普林斯顿与斯坦福开源的研究型智能体，用于修复 GitHub 仓库里的 issue。

candidates.name: mini-SWE-agent
candidates.description: Deliberately minimal open-source software-engineering agent that uses only bash.
candidates.zh_description: 只用 bash 的极简开源软件工程智能体。

candidates.name: PR-Agent (Qodo)
candidates.description: Open-source pull-request review agent from Qodo with a hosted edition.
candidates.zh_description: Qodo 开源的 Pull Request 审查智能体，另有托管版。

candidates.name: CodeRabbit

candidates.zh_description: Sourcegraph 面向编辑器与终端的智能体编程工具。

candidates.name: Warp

candidates.zh_description: 内置智能体的终端，可用自然语言执行命令与修改代码。

candidates.name: Augment Code

candidates.zh_description: 面向大型代码库的托管编程智能体与上下文引擎，运行于常见 IDE。

candidates.name: Codegen

candidates.zh_description: 从聊天与工单系统接任务并提交 Pull Request 的托管软件工程智能体。

candidates.name: Factory Droids

candidates.zh_description: Factory 的托管软件开发智能体，可在终端、IDE 与 CI 中运行。

candidates.name: Void
candidates.description: Open-source AI code editor that connects directly to any model provider.
candidates.zh_description: 直接接任意模型供应商的开源 AI 代码编辑器。

candidates.name: JetBrains Junie
candidates.description: JetBrains' coding agent for its IDEs that plans and applies multi-step changes.
candidates.zh_description: JetBrains 面向自家 IDE 的编程智能体，可规划并执行多步改动。

candidates.name: Amazon Q Developer
candidates.description: AWS's coding assistant and agent for the IDE and command line, with an open-source CLI.
candidates.zh_description: AWS 面向 IDE 与命令行的编程助手与智能体，命令行工具已开源。

candidates.name: Refact.ai
candidates.description: Open-source AI coding agent and self-hostable server for IDEs.
candidates.zh_description: 开源的 AI 编程智能体与可自托管服务端，运行于 IDE。

candidates.name: Potpie

candidates.zh_description: 基于代码库知识图谱构建自定义智能体的开源平台。

candidates.name: GPT Pilot (Pythagora)
